subject: general
question: Who is called the father of the modern Indian dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uday Shankar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Uday Shankar is considered the father of the modern Indian dance as he introduced a new form of dance that blended Indian classical dance with Western ballet.
 
• He founded the first Indian dance company, which toured extensively in Europe and the US.</stro
